orespawn_integrations.odete.npc.name: Odete
orespawn_integrations.odete.npc.title: Registry Clerk
orespawn_integrations.odete.dialog.title: Registry · Window 1
orespawn_integrations.odete.dialog.text: One scrap, one wrong thing, one right thing. Sign here. No, here. Come back tomorrow for the copy.
orespawn_integrations.odete.que_sistema: The Ledger. It tore lengthwise. Next!
orespawn_integrations.odete.averbado: Registered. One slip now; the copy's out tomorrow. Next!
orespawn_integrations.odete.segunda_via: Your copy, checked by p.p. B. See? Tomorrow always comes.
orespawn_integrations.odete.cedo: The copy's tomorrow. Today is still today.
orespawn_integrations.odete.nada_pendent: No copy on file under your name.
orespawn_integrations.odete.sem_retalho: No scrap, no registration. Come back with paper.
orespawn_integrations.odete.sem_cortesia: The courtesy is for brokers. It says here you're not one.
orespawn_integrations.odete.primeira_via: Checked: p.p. B., day %s. Funny: he always signs with tomorrow's date.
orespawn_integrations.odete.cortesia: The broker's courtesy. Signed, stamped, free of charge. Next!
orespawn_integrations.odete.cortesia_ja: Today's courtesy is already paid. Come back tomorrow.
orespawn_integrations.odete.via_hoje: Registered, and the copy's out today. Exceptionally. Next!
orespawn_integrations.odete.fechado: This window is closed until further notice. Take a number.
orespawn_integrations.odete_campo.saudac: Good morning. This fall is not in the system. Neither is the applicant. Let's fix both.
Good afternoon. This fall is not in the system. Neither is the applicant. Let's fix both.
Good evening. This fall is not in the system. Neither is the applicant. Let's fix both.
Old applicant, new file. The fall ran late too: seventy-seven years.
orespawn_integrations.odete_campo.moedas: Finders keepers. Like your little egg: officially, I didn't see.
orespawn_integrations.correcoes.campo.re: You had this one already. Now you have two.
orespawn_integrations.correcoes.campo.su: Returned to the Royal Wardrobe. The Wardrobe, as it happens, is you.
orespawn_integrations.correcoes.campo.jo: People's hats are asked for, not corrected.
orespawn_integrations.correcoes.campo.co: An owned animal: the hat goes home with it.
orespawn_integrations.correcoes.campo.ge: That little egg has an owner.
orespawn_integrations.correction.jei.row: Another world's uranium, entered as the King's. The weight a furnace gives. The crusher gives more.
Old man's beard is the Hoard's, sweetie. With Treasury paper it's auntie's moss.
The Hoard eats the Land's crab and calls it the King's. Sign here.
Double entry: two swords on one form. The Land allows a swap; we reverse the other.
It comes out new: enchantments don't come along.
Another world's titanium, entered as the King's. In nuggets: the King signs for no bars.
orespawn_integrations.correction.jei.r1: The Old Ground's ruby is the Land's and the court's is the court's. No correction for that.
orespawn_integrations.correction.jei.r2: Hero titanium belongs to World No. 53. No correction for that.
orespawn_integrations.registro.ops.desli: The Registry is switched off in this server's config.
orespawn_integrations.registro.ops.cheio: The desk list is full: %s desks.
